entry.label: Assetto Corsa

support.note: Protocol validated live on 2026-10-11 by the probe script (scripts/probe_ac.py, ks_audi_r8_plus at ks_silverstone): the handshake is answered (408 B UTF-16), RTCarInfo streams at 59.8 Hz (14,356 packets in 240 s, 0 rejected), isInPit sits at byte 24, RTLap (212 B) decodes on a second SPOT socket. pitwall's decoder and lap logic are validated on that recording (tests/recorded): one real lap crossing, timed 2:18.817 from lastLap in the crossing packet, and a restored state correctly not counted. Not yet run through pitwall's own client and service on the console: no AC lap has been stored, timed or coached end to end, and the service does not subscribe to RTLap. The console does not report the track layout, so layouts share a track id and are told apart by track length only.

transport.summary: Pitwall registers with the game (UDP 9996); nothing to set in the game.

features.label: Lap times
features.reason: Assetto Corsa sends lap times.
features.detail: lap_number: lapCount @52 + 1 (lapCount = completed laps; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed)); current_lap_time_ms: lapTime @40 (ms; restarts at the line; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed)); last_lap_time_ms: lastLap @44 (ms; 0 -> None; updated in the crossing packet on PS5); lap_completion: derived: lapCount increment with lapTime restarting (or restarting within 0.5 s), time = lastLap from the crossing packet, else a just-received RTLap, else held up to 0.5 s; one completion per lap; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed): ONE real crossing (lastLap = 138,817 ms in the crossing packet) plus a restored state that is correctly not a lap. Not yet run end to end in the service (row ac_ps5)

features.label: Live delta
features.reason: Assetto Corsa sends no lap distance: Pitwall works it out from the track position once the track length is known (your first full lap measures it).
features.detail: lap_distance_m: derived: (carPositionNormalized @308 - line) x track length; line = spline 0 when the first increment coincides with the spline wrap (PS5: yes), else learned from two crossings; None until line and length are known; laps scaled by an unconfirmed length estimate are completed valid=False; current_lap_time_ms: lapTime @40 (ms; restarts at the line; PS5 capture (PS4 build, 2026-10-11 live probe, replayed)) (row ac_ps5)

notes: Implemented from Kunos' Remote Telemetry spec (field list) + observed sizes and two MIT clients (layout). PS5 (PS4 build), 2026-10-11: the probe script validated the protocol live (handshake answered, 14,356 RTCarInfo at 59.8 Hz, 0 rejected); this adapter is validated on that recorded capture (tests/recorded/test_ac_ps5_real.py: one lap crossing). pitwall's own client/service path, lap storage and coaching are still to be run on a full AC session.
pitwall must handshake with the game (UDP 9996) - nothing to configure in the game; re-registers per session.

Lap distance = spline position x track length: spline 0 is the line when the first crossing coincides with the spline wrap (PS5); the length is estimated after ~15-25 % of a lap from that crossing, then fixed by the first full lap (or known from an earlier session). Laps scaled by an unconfirmed estimate are void.
Steering is not mapped (unit undocumented). No tyre, fuel, sector, validity or weather data in the protocol.

The console's trackConfig repeats the track name: layouts of one track share a track id. Stored geometry of another layout is rejected by the first full lap's length check; references, comparisons and track models downstream are restricted to sessions of a compatible track length (within 3 %).
